PayrollAdjustment.title: Payroll Adjustment
PayrollAdjustment.description: A terugwerkende kracht (TWK) correction for a SEALED prior-period payslip, modeled as a DELTA -- never a mutation of the original Payslip/PayrollRun (retro-adjustments design.md D1). RetroAdjustmentService recomputes the original period against ITS OWN tax year (same-tax-year MVP -- design.md D2) with the corrected input, diffs recomputed minus stored into the delta* fields, and -- once applied -- the delta is settled as a nabetaling/terugvordering component of the CURRENT run's payslip (Payslip.retroAdjustment), never by reopening the sealed original. Idempotently keyed on (originalPeriod, employeeId, correctionRef) -- re-running the same correction updates this same object in place.

originalPayrollRunId.title: Original payroll run ID
originalPayrollRunId.description: The SEALED PayrollRun (approved/posted/paid) whose payslip is being corrected. This run and its payslip are never recomputed or rewritten by this change.

originalPayslipId.title: Original payslip ID
originalPayslipId.description: The SEALED original Payslip the delta was diffed against (recomputed - stored). Read-only reference, resolved by RetroAdjustmentService; feeds the corpus self-check (nl-retro-adjustment-consistency). Never rewritten.

originalPeriod.title: Original period
originalPeriod.description: The wage period being corrected, YYYY-MM. The tax year for the recompute is ALWAYS derived from THIS period (nl-{year of originalPeriod}), never the settlement period's or the current year's (same-tax-year MVP).

correctionType.title: Correction type
correctionType.description: Free-text classification of the correction (e.g. backdated-raise, contract-correction, sick-day-correction). Informational only.

correctedGrossMonthlySalary.title: Corrected gross monthly salary
correctedGrossMonthlySalary.description: The corrected gross monthly salary the recompute uses in place of the originally-stored figure.

correctionRef.title: Correction ref
correctionRef.description: Caller-supplied stable idempotency key for one correction event. Re-running the same (originalPeriod, employeeId, correctionRef) updates this SAME PayrollAdjustment in place rather than creating a duplicate (REQ-RETRO-003).

deltaNet.title: Delta net
deltaNet.description: recomputed.nettoPay - stored.nettoPay, cents-exact -- the amount settled as a nabetaling (positive) or terugvordering (negative) into the current run's Payslip.nettoPay once applied.

engineVersion.title: Engine version
engineVersion.description: The versioned tax-year table (e.g. nl-2026) the recompute used -- always derived from originalPeriod's year, never the current year (nl-retro-adjustment-consistency; same-tax-year MVP -- design.md D2). Null until first computed.

settlementPeriod.title: Settlement period
settlementPeriod.description: The CURRENT open period this delta is settled into. Defaults to the most recent open draft PayrollRun's period when not given explicitly.

settlementPayrollRunId.title: Settlement payroll run ID
settlementPayrollRunId.description: The PayrollRun of settlementPeriod, stamped once this adjustment is applied. Null while draft.

settlementLine.title: Settlement line
settlementLine.description: Whether the delta is a nabetaling (positive net delta, paid out to the employee) or a terugvordering (negative net delta, clawed back).

status.title: Status
status.description: draft = computed but not yet settled into any run (affects no payslip); applied = settled -- surfaces in the settlementPeriod run's Payslip.retroAdjustment. Plain enum, deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle map (the PayrollRunDetail precedent -- retro-adjustments design.md D8): driving lifecycleActions here would invent a transition the backend does not guard.
